nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name (EtherBunny).
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token ticker (eBunny).
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 18.
uint256 _totalSupply state variable holding the total token supply.
mapping(address => uint) balances storing token balances of accounts.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
EtherBunny constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply() view function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) view function reading balances mapping.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) view function reading allowed mapping.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) adjusts balances via safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) adjusts balances and allowed via safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) performing checked addition.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) performing checked subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) performing checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) performing checked division.
msg.sender used as trusted caller for balances keys, allowance keys and transfer operations.
Unchecked-until-require addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; arithmetic overflow guarded only by require(c >= a).
Unchecked-until-require subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv; guarded by require(b > 0).
